description: Trace capture fidelity for behavioral analysis: write the approved 100000-character capture limit to Claude Code and Pi, stop counting plugin root parents as capture gaps, and document the limit, the trade-off, and the root cause.

userStories.title: Write the approved capture limit to each harness
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro langfuse apply` to set the plugin capture limit to 100000 characters so that the plugins truncate fewer fields.
acceptanceCriteria: A failing test is committed before the change, then passes: the Claude Code writer puts `CC_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS: "100000"` in the `env` block of `~/.claude/settings.json` and keeps every other key.
A failing test is committed before the change, then passes: the fragment renders `PI_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS=100000` after the four existing keys.
One exported constant holds the value `100000`. Both writers read that constant.
`pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm run build` exit 0 in the task worktree.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: red commit 3d7b3a94 (vitest tracing exit 1), green after b25fa532. 2 executed: same red/green, fragment renders PI_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS=100000 fifth. 3 reasoned: LANGFUSE_PLUGIN_MAX_CHARS in providers/langfuse.ts read by both writers. 4 executed on task branch: typecheck 0, test 0 (2402 passed, 2 skipped), build 0.

userStories.title: Stop counting plugin root parents as capture gaps
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want the adapter to skip the parent of a root observation so that the capture report counts only real gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: A failing test is committed before the change, then passes: a fixture row with `isRootObservation: true` and an absent parent adds no `parent` entry to `capture.missing`.
A test proves that a non-root row with an absent parent still adds a `parent` entry.
The normalized event keeps `isRootObservation`, and `references/run-files.md` names the field.
`pnpm test` exits 0 in the task worktree.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: red commit 2f9cd503 (23 normalize tests failed), green after 46601623; root row adds no missing or crossSession entry and triggers no lookup. 2 executed: non-root rows with false and null keep parent gaps. 3 executed: event carries isRootObservation; run-files.md names it; ste-check exit 0. 4 executed on task branch: typecheck 0, test 0 (2404 passed, 2 skipped), build 0. Finding: facts.mjs:251 isBoundary misses Claude Code turn roots with a phantom parent; deferred to Close.

userStories.title: Document the limit, the trade-off, and the root cause
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `docs/integrations/langfuse.md` to state the capture limit and its cost so that I can change the limit with full knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/integrations/langfuse.md` states the 100000 limit for Claude Code and Pi, and the privacy and cost trade-off.
The Codex section no longer names `LANGFUSE_CODEX_MAX_CHARS`, because plugin 0.4.2 has no such setting.
`references/langfuse-adapter.md` explains the root-parent rule and cites the Claude Code plugin behavior.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh` exits 0 on each changed Markdown file.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript so that I can see the new limit and the new gap count on real output.
acceptanceCriteria: `evidence/manual-review.md` shows `agro langfuse apply` output with a temporary `HOME`, and the rendered `CC_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS` and `PI_LANGFUSE_MAX_CHARS` values.
`evidence/manual-review.md` shows aggregate missing-parent counts before and after the US-002 rule on one fixture. It holds no transcript content and no secret.
The temporary `HOME` is deleted after the run.
